tasks.title: Tortoise race
tasks.description: Two tortoises A and B run a race. A starts with a lead g; B is faster. Given speeds v1 and v2 and lead g, return [hour, min, sec], rounded down to the nearest second, for B to catch A. When v1 >= v2, return null. Examples: race(720, 850, 70) => [0, 32, 18]; race(80, 91, 37) => [3, 21, 49].

tasks.title: Digits in reverse order
tasks.description: Convert a non-negative number to an array of its digits in reverse order. For example, digitize(123) returns [3, 2, 1].

tasks.title: Remove spaces
tasks.description: Simple: remove the spaces from a string, then return the resultant string. For example, noSpace('8 j 8   mBliB8g  imjB8B8  jl  B') returns '8j8mBliB8gimjB8B8jlB'.
